title: Bilt POS SDK WebSurface bridge messages
description: Messages exchanged between the SDK's WebSurface and the hosted renderer page. Outbound messages are passed as the single argument of window.BiltMedia.receive(message); inbound messages are the string the page posts to the platform's JavaScript interface, which the host forwards to WebSurface.onBridgeMessage. No message carries PII.

inbound.description: Page to SDK. The SDK accepts only these types and only for the creative currently on display; anything else is dropped and reported to WebSurface.onBridgeError.

oneOf.description: The renderer page has installed window.BiltMedia.receive and can accept messages. Sent once per page load.
The shopper tapped a CTA. creativeId and token must match the rendering on display and action must match that CTA's declared action.
viewed: the creative met the page's viewability rule (at most once). dismissed: the shopper closed it from the page's own close affordance. completed: its video played to the end.

ttlMs.description: Freshness bound in milliseconds, rounded up to a whole millisecond.

tracking.description: Tracking beacons keyed by event name, e.g. impression and viewability.

durationMs.description: Video running time in milliseconds, rounded up to a whole millisecond.

poster.description: Still frame shown before a video starts.

token.description: Opaque token minted by the ad platform for this CTA on this creative in this session. Returned verbatim; never constructed by the page.
